title: Republicans
intro: Claims Republican officials made, set against the record.

charts.title: Republicans: Records by Section
charts.note: Tap a bar or key line to open that section.

republicans-1.title: Mexico pays
lines: The claim: Mexico will pay for the wall.
The record: Mexico did not pay. Congress appropriated American money. A chant is not a wire transfer.
republicans-1.label: On the record

republicans-2.title: Repeal
lines: The claim: Repeal and replace on day one.
The record: Full Republican control in 2017. The repeal failed on the Senate floor. The promise was the campaign.
republicans-2.label: On the record

republicans-3.title: Proven stolen
lines: The claim: The 2020 election was proven stolen in court.

The record: Dozens of cases were filed. None established outcome-changing fraud. On December 11, 2020, the Supreme Court denied Texas leave to file its suit against Pennsylvania, Georgia, Michigan and Wisconsin.
republicans-3.label: On the record

republicans-4.title: Pence can flip it
lines: The claim: The vice president can reject the electoral votes.
The record: The Twelfth Amendment makes him the presiding officer, not a second electorate. The theory was rejected. The pressure on him was real.
republicans-4.label: On the record

republicans-5.title: Fight like hell
lines: The claim: He only said peacefully.
The record: He said both. “Peacefully and patriotically” and “fight like hell” are on one Ellipse tape. Owning only the soft line is clipping.
republicans-5.label: On the record

republicans-6.title: The 34 counts
lines: The claim: The New York case is fake. Ignore the verdict.
The record: A jury convicted on 34 counts of falsifying business records. The novel predicate is why it is on appeal. “Fake” erases the jury. That is not the file.
republicans-6.label: On the record

republicans-7.title: I alone
lines: The claim: I alone can fix it.
The record: Article I still holds the purse. One man does not appropriate. The sentence was a campaign. The charter did not move.
republicans-7.label: On the record

republicans-8.title: No new taxes
lines: The claim: Read my lips. No new taxes.
The record: George H. W. Bush, 1988. The 1990 budget deal raised them. The mouth and the statute did not match.
republicans-8.label: On the record

republicans-9.title: Death panels
lines: The claim: The health bill creates death panels.
The record: The phrase was a caption for end-of-life counseling language. It was not a board that voted on who dies.
republicans-9.label: On the record
